units.source_text: 看到这种收官，使人产生一种秩序井然的美感，恍如看到了灵捷的机械、快速的计算机飞速地运转，令人愉悦。

en.t: Seeing this kind of endgame gives one a sense of orderly beauty, as if watching a nimble machine or a high-speed computer running at full speed, which is deeply pleasing.

units.source_text: 虽说是弈战，却以美的形式表现出来。

en.t: Although it is a battle on the board, it appears in the form of beauty.

units.source_text: 加上棋手目不他视，更增添了美感。

en.t: Together with the players' refusal to look elsewhere, this adds still more to the sense of beauty.
